title: Release Train Pulseboard: cross-team milestones, content freeze, and release-notes coordination
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Objective: Create a single 'Pulseboard' operational plan that coordinates milestones, scope/content freeze, cut criteria, and the release-notes workflow across API, Console, and Runtime teams so launch activities are synchronized and external comms are reliable.

Why: Recent launches showed drift: console docs published before console UX was feature-complete; runtime performance notes missed quantization caveats; API breaking-change bullet was delayed. The Pulseboard reduces drift by centralizing milestones, deterministic cut criteria, and a single release-notes authoring and approval flow.

Success criteria: (1) No cross-team content drift for public-facing release notes; (2) All launch blockers tracked with owners and resolved before code freeze; (3) Release notes published within 24 hours of GA; (4) Post-launch incident rate within baseline SLA for first 72 hours.
milestones: M1: Scope alignment workshop — 2026-02-24 — outcomes: feature list, per-team must-have vs nice-to-have
M2: Content freeze for public-facing features — 2026-03-04 23:59 UTC — only critical fixes accepted
M3: Cut criteria review and sign-off (PM/Eng/Design/Security) — 2026-03-08
M4: Release candidate validation (API contract tests, Console E2E, Runtime perf run) — 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-14
M5: Final sign-off & docs publish window — 2026-03-17
cut_criteria: No P0 regressions in the last 48 hours for API, Console, or Runtime
End-to-end smoke tests pass (contract + auth + rate limiting + streaming) on staging
Runtime: 95th percentile latency within 1.2x of target for typical test workload
Console: Critical UX flows (create model route, view metrics, rollout toggles) pass manual QA
Docs: Release notes draft ready and approved by PM and Legal
Security/Compliance: Pending high/critical security findings mitigated or accepted by Security
release_notes_plan: Single master release-notes draft in Drive (ReleaseNotes/2026-03-train) maintained by PM writer (Priya). Team owners assert sections by the content freeze date. Workflow: owners add change bullet -> reviewer (technical lead) adds implementation/compatibility notes -> PM edits canonical wording -> Legal/Security review -> Marketing final sign-off. Publish runs through console/docs CDN and is mirrored to changelog API. Post-GA short summary email template prepared for key customers.
stakeholders: Product: Priya Nair (owner), Ava Chen (Console PM)
Engineering: Marcus Reed (runtime delivery lead), Diego Alvarez (API infra lead)
communication_plan: Weekly sync (Tue 09:30 PT) + daily standups in final 7 days. Pulseboard Slack channel #rel-train-2026-03 for blockers. Status template: milestone, blockers, ship-impacting? yes/no, owner. PM to send milestone reminders at M2 and M4 and a pre-GA readiness survey to stakeholders. Postmortem to be scheduled 1 week post-GA and a lessons-learned doc added to the release folder.
risks: Runtime perf regression discovered during RC runs causing throughput loss — mitigation: isolate canary with reduced traffic and fallback to previous quantized variant
Docs lag where Console UI text differs from release notes — mitigation: docs owner runs final UI sweep and attaches screenshots to release notes
API contract mismatch for streaming endpoints — mitigation: contract tests gated in CI and a compatibility shim plan ready
dependencies: ENG-5842: Runtime kernel selection update (must land before RC)
PM-11902: Dedicated capacity pricing notes (for marketing blurb)
decisions: Decision: Use single authoritative release-notes doc instead of per-team posts — agreed 2026-02-25
Decision: Allow only P0 bug fixes after content freeze; P1 fixes require documented PM/Eng approval
Decision: Default rollout strategy is region-by-region with automatic capacity-based ramping; emergency full-fallback to previous model config if errors > threshold
open_questions: Do we require SSO migration notes in this release (affects enterprise customers)? (owner: Security)
Should we include quantization caveats in the public performance section or behind an advanced tech note? (owner: Marcus Reed)
Final decision on marketing demo environment availability window? (owner: Marketing)
Who will own the post-GA customer webinar? (owner: Developer Relations)
Are there any compliance customers with a freeze window that blocks our GA date? (owner: Support)
What is the exact wording for 'Known limitations' for streaming fallback behavior?
